article.title: Israel is rewriting the Palestinian curriculum in East Jerusalem to erase Palestinian identity
article.author: Aseel Mafarjeh
article.content: Nearly 38 percent of Palestinian students in East Jerusalem now study the Israeli curriculum, while the rest of the students' textbooks are being censored line by line, stripping mention of Jerusalem, prisoners, the Nakba, and freedom fighters.
